desc: #39 (an Adreno handheld reset at Rogueport's harbour): the harbour arrival and walk on Vulkan (the API Android plays on) with robust buffer access forced on (AURORA_ROBUST=1, as Qualcomm GPUs and phones now always have it): the log says it is on and how many threads compile pipelines; compared with a run of this scenario without it (--env AURORA_ROBUST=0), the captures match: robustness changes nothing that is drawn
